chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Umar ibn Aban, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'All goodness is in the sword and beneath the shadow of the sword; and nothing can straighten the people except the sword, and the swords are the keys of Paradise and the Fire.'

key_terms.السَّيْفِ: the sword — here used to represent armed combat and jihad
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ: Paradise and the Fire — the two ultimate abodes in the hereafter
key_terms.الْخَيْرُ: goodness/welfare — all forms of benefit, spiritual and worldly
key_terms.مَقَالِيدُ: keys — instruments that open or close; here: keys to one's ultimate destiny
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: to straighten/reform/establish — making people upright in religion and society

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the sword and its role in Islam according to al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith is transmitted from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) who attributes it to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW). It presents a forceful statement on the role of the sword — meaning armed jihad — in establishing justice, reforming society, and determining one's ultimate fate. In the early Muslim context, the sword was the primary instrument of both defensive and offensive military action, and the statement that swords are 'keys of Paradise and the Fire' means that how one wields or engages with the sword (in righteous or unjust cause) determines one's eschatological destiny.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Umar Bin Aban, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The goodness, all of it is in the sword, and beneath the shadow of the sword; and nothing can straighten the people except for the sword, and the swords are the keys of the Paradise and the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ‘Umar ibn Aban from abu ‘Abd Allah ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘All good things are with the sword, under the shadow (protection) of sword and people cannot be improved without the sword. Swords are the key to paradise or hellfire.’”
